annotation.summary_en: A boss tries to book a month-long romantic getaway in Spain with his female employee under the guise of an office project until his wife returns unexpectedly.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch is set in an office where a mustached director and a female coworker are sitting closely together at a computer desk. They are discussing an upcoming trip to Spain or Italy, looking for an all-inclusive hotel near the sea. The director insists on a month-long stay to 'truly understand each other,' and tells the woman he will lie to his wife, claiming it is a business trip (commandirovka). He dismisses the idea of ever taking a wife to a hotel, calling it inappropriate for a 'decent director.' He instructs the woman to book a double room with a single bed. Just as they are finalized with the plans, a flamboyant woman in drag—wearing a bright yellow jacket, a red wig, and sunglasses—bursts into the room. Caught in the act, the director immediately changes his tone, pretending they are discussing office logistics. He frantically tells the employee to add a note to the document about a 'lack of seating' and to request 'additional chairs,' trying to mask the romantic booking as a mundane office supply issue before his angry wife.
